item.title: Triple digit growth for Alpine in 2025

item.description: Renault delivered a strong performance in 2025, with 1,628,030 vehicles sold worldwide, (+3.2% increase PC+LCV vs 2024), driven by a +10% growth in global passenger car sales (1,292,000 units sold).
